paper_analogy: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Graphs for Autonomous Search-and-Track
source: training_data.csv, Machine == 'Intuition', 6 row(s), 1 auto-detected run(s)/playthroughs. Graph built directly from the PTT (Penetration Testing Tree) field's growth.

analogy_mapping.Agent Nodes: PTT snapshot reached after each new tree item (state = cumulative tree)
analogy_mapping.Search Nodes: The PTT tree item worked on (number + title) + its MCP_tasks tool calls
analogy_mapping.Track Nodes: That item's findings payload -- what was actually discovered

node_types.Agent (Blue/Pink goal): PTT state after a new item completes
node_types.Search (Orange): PTT item being worked (tool calls in tooltip)

edge_types.StateTransition (Black): Agent -> Agent, label = PTT item number
edge_types.SearchUpdate (Green): Agent -> Search, item being worked from that state
edge_types.TrackUpdate (Blue): Search -> Track, what item's execution found
edge_types.Prediction (Purple): Track -> Agent, leads to next cumulative PTT state
